Definition: Jekamjah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jecamiah or Jekamiah = "Jehovah raises"; 1) a descendant of Judah, son of Shallum in the line of Ahlai; 2) a descendant of David and one of the seven introduced into the royal line on the failure of it in the person of Jehoiachin
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
